content.title: About
content.content: Pre‑gelatinized millet flour is a dry product made from whole millet grains that have undergone partial hydration and drying. This treatment improves solubility and thickening ability, making it convenient for gluten‑free recipes, sauces, and desserts.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Millet is one of the oldest cultivated grains, grown for over 7,000 years in Africa and Asia.
Pre‑gelatinized flour forms a gel instantly without prolonged heating.
Millet is naturally gluten‑free, popular among people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.
The flour has a neutral taste, allowing easy pairing with various flavors.
Gelatinization makes the starch more accessible to digestive enzymes, enhancing its nutritional value.

items.title: Rich in complex carbohydrates
items.content: Provides a slow release of energy, helping to maintain stable blood sugar levels.

items.title: Source of dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber supports healthy digestion and promotes satiety.

items.title: Contains magnesium and phosphorus
items.content: These minerals are essential for muscle, nerve, and bone function.

items.title: Low glycemic index
items.content: Pre‑gelatinized millet flour has a lower GI compared with regular starches.

items.title: Gluten‑free
items.content: Suitable for gluten‑free diets, reducing the risk of adverse reactions.

items.title: Cereal allergy
items.content: While rare, some individuals may be allergic to millet.

items.title: Phytic acid content
items.content: Phytic acid can hinder mineral absorption; soaking or fermenting helps reduce it for frequent consumers.

items.title: Excess carbohydrate intake
items.content: Large portions may contribute to weight gain if overall calorie balance is not managed.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Use pre‑gelatinized millet flour in gluten‑free breads, pancakes, muffins, sauces, soups, and desserts. Its instant thickening makes it ideal for cold drinks and smoothies. Combine with other gluten‑free flours to improve texture.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in an airtight container in a cool, dry, dark place. For longer shelf life, keep refrigerated to prevent mold growth and fat oxidation.
